scripts.build:client: npx esbuild server/routes/vendor_cloud_routes.ts --bundle --packages=external --format=esm --platform=node --target=es2022 --outfile=server/routes/vendor_cloud_routes.js && npx esbuild src/vendor_entry.tsx --bundle --minify --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=assets/vendor_client.js && cp assets/vendor_client.js public/assets/vendor_client.js 2>/dev/null || true
